description: This Kotlin source file defines the LocalDataStore class responsible for persisting and retrieving Task objects using SharedPreferences. It provides methods to load and save task data asynchronously with coroutine support, serializing tasks to JSON format.

classes.name: LocalDataStore
classes.description: Class responsible for persisting Task objects in SharedPreferences as JSON and providing asynchronous load and save methods.

methods.name: loadTasks
methods.description: Suspended function to load the list of tasks from SharedPreferences asynchronously.

methods.name: saveTasks
methods.description: Suspended function to serialize and save a list of tasks into SharedPreferences asynchronously.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Private extension function converting a Task object into a JSONObject.

methods.name: toTask
methods.description: Private extension function converting a JSONObject into a Task object.
